newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-TOSHACK EMBARRASSED BY DEPORTIVO SQUAD RICHES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TOSHACK EMBARRASSED BY DEPORTIVO SQUAD RICHES.

text.p: Deportivo Coruna president Augusto Lendoiro has moved to support coach John Toshack after the Welshman clashed with several players who complained about not being picked enough.
"It's simply an anecdote," said Lendoiro, explaining he also understood the anxieties of players such as former Spain midfielder Rafael Martin Vazquez.
The ex-Real Madrid man had criticised Toshack after being brought on as substitute in the second half of Sunday's 1-0 win at Sevilla, only to be taken off again later in the game.
"He's quite wrong if he thinks that hurting the squad is especially motivating," said Martin Vazquez.
"I don't make changes just for the sake of it," said Toshack "My mistake was bringing him on in the first place."
Deportivo's strength in depth means that players such as Czech Euro 96 goalkeeper Peter Kouba are yet to make their league debut.
Toshack courted controversy last season when he dropped Brazilian World Cup forward Bebeto, who has since left the club.
With 16 foreigners already in their ranks, Deportivo are nevertheless awaiting reinforcements in December, among them Brazilian striker Renaldo and Portuguese defender Helder.
